slides.title: What do you *complain about most?*
slides.sub: It usually points to what you care about most.

slides.title: Make the list
slides.body: Think back over the last two weeks. What did you grumble about more than once? Write down the top three.

slides.title: Find the value under it
slides.body: Under each complaint, ask: what would I have to care about to be this bothered? Write that one word.

slides.title: Look at the gap
slides.body: If you care about it that much, are you acting like it? Or only noticing when it's missing?

slides.title: One small move
slides.body: Pick one word from your list. Do one thing this week that protects it, instead of only complaining when it's gone.
